description: This file defines the WeightClass model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve weight class records and their descriptions from the database, specifically for the admin localisations module.

classes.name: WeightClass
classes.description: Model class for managing weight units and their descriptions in the Opencart admin localisation module.

methods.name: addWeightClass
methods.description: Creates a new weight class record in the database and adds its localized descriptions, returning the primary key.

methods.name: editWeightClass
methods.description: Updates an existing weight class record and its descriptions in the database.

methods.name: deleteWeightClass
methods.description: Removes a weight class and its descriptions from the database.

methods.name: getWeightClass
methods.description: Retrieves a weight class record along with its description for the current language.

methods.name: getWeightClasses
methods.description: Fetches multiple weight class records, optionally filtered and sorted, with caching.

methods.name: getTotalWeightClasses
methods.description: Returns the total count of weight class records, with optional filtering.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description entry for a specific weight class and language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific weight class.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all weight class descriptions for a specified language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description for a weight class in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Gets all description records for a weight class.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all weight class descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByUnit
methods.description: Fetches description records matching a specific unit in the current language.
